local function load_all()
    for _, name in ipairs({ "loot", "gathered", "shop_stock" }) do
        local t = loadTable("aw_loot_" .. name)
        rows[name] = (type(t) == "table") and t or {}
    end

    local idx = loadTable("aw_loot_index")
    if type(idx) == "table" then
        if type(idx.index) == "table" then statIndex = idx.index end
        if type(idx.pending) == "table" then statPend = idx.pending end
    end

    local bags = loadTable("aw_loot_bags")
    if type(bags) == "table" then my_bags = bags end

    local con = loadTable("aw_loot_consent")
    if type(con) == "table" then consent = con end

    refresh_players()

    local saved = loadTable("aw_loot_cfg")
    if type(saved) == "table" then
        for k, v in pairs(saved) do
            if cfg[k] ~= nil then cfg[k] = v end
        end
    end

    exclude     = csv_set(cfg.bags)
    bonus_flags = csv_set(cfg.flags)
end

local function status()
    utilprint(TAG .. commas(count_of("loot")) .. " loot, "
        .. commas(count_of("shop_stock")) .. " shop, "
        .. commas(count_of("gathered")) .. " gathered, "
        .. commas(count_of("item_stats")) .. " with stats.")

    local p = pending_all()
    utilprint("$w  " .. (cfg.authname ~= "" and ("pooled as " .. cfg.authname)
        or "not authenticated - '/loot auth'")
        .. (p > 0 and ("  -  " .. commas(p) .. " row(s) waiting to upload") or ""))
    utilprint("$K  identify wish " .. (cfg.idwish and "yes" or "no")
        .. ", auto identify " .. (cfg.autoid and "on" or "off")
        .. (((cfg.autoid and not cfg.idwish)) and "  (idle without the wish)" or "") .. "$w")
end

function init()
    load_all()

    --[[
        Core sends 'tags on' and gags the protocol noise. A gagged line still
        reaches every trigger, so these read the tags Core is hiding — there is
        no hand-off to arrange, unlike Mudlet where two plugins calling
        deleteLine on one line ate the line after it.
    ]]
    broadcastPlugin("aw-gmcp", "Char,Room")

    addTrigger("^You get (.+?) from the .*?corpse of (.+)\\.$", on_loot, { type = "regex" })
    addTrigger("^You get (.+?) from (.+)\\.$", on_get, { type = "regex" })
    addTrigger("^\\s*\\d+\\s+(\\d+)\\s+(\\d+)\\s+---\\s+(\\S.*?)\\s*$", on_shop, { type = "regex" })

    addTrigger("^\\{invitem\\}(.+)$", on_invitem, { type = "regex" })
    addTrigger("^\\{invdata\\}$", on_invdata_start, { type = "regex" })
    addTrigger("^\\{/invdata\\}$", on_invdata_end, { type = "regex" })

    addTrigger("^\\| Keywords\\s+:\\s*(.+?)\\s*\\|$", on_id_start, { type = "regex" })

    --[[
        Core classifies roomchars as a marker, so it hides the two wrapper
        lines and leaves the contents on screen. A gagged line still reaches
        every trigger either way, so this sees the block regardless.
    ]]
    addTrigger("^\\{roomchars\\}", rc_open, { type = "regex" })

    -- one parse of a shop list, not two: see on_shop_list
    pcall(on, "aw.shop.list", on_shop_list)
    shop_plugin = plugin_on("aw-shop")

    --[[
        'inv' goes to the MUD untouched and invdata goes out beside it, purely
        so the container types can be learned. The MUD's own inventory is what
        you read; Core gags the tagged reply.
    ]]
    addAlias("^(?:i|in|inv|inve|inven|invent|invento|inventor|inventory)$", "", function()
        send("inv")
        if cfg.inv then send("invdata") end
    end, { name = "aw-loot-inv" })

    addAlias("^appraise\\s+(\\d+)\\s*-\\s*(\\d+)$", "", function(m)
        bulk_appraise(m[2], m[3])
    end, { name = "aw-loot-bulk-appraise" })

    registerCommand("loot", function(args)
        local a = args
        if type(a) == "table" then a = table.concat(a, " ") end
        a = trim(a)

        local verb, rest = string.match(a, "^(%S*)%s*(.*)$")
        verb = low(verb or "")
        rest = trim(rest)

        if verb == "" or verb == "status" then status()

        elseif verb == "item" then show_item(rest)
        elseif verb == "mob" then show_mob(rest)
        elseif verb == "shop" then show_shop(rest)
        elseif verb == "stats" or verb == "stat" then show_stats(rest)
        elseif verb == "gathered" or verb == "gather" then show_gathered(rest)
        elseif verb == "recent" then show_recent()
        elseif verb == "del" or verb == "forget" or verb == "remove" then del_item(rest)

        elseif verb == "id" then
            if rest == "" then
                utilprint(TAGR .. "usage: /loot id <keyword>   (or '/loot autoid')")
            else
                send("id " .. rest)
            end

        elseif verb == "here" or verb == "ground" then
            if rest == "" then
                utilprint(TAGR .. "usage: /loot here <keyword>   (picks it up and records the spawn)")
            else
                here_arm()
                send("get " .. rest)
            end

        elseif verb == "consent" then
            if rest == "" then
                local names = {}
                for n in pairs(consent) do table.insert(names, n) end
                table.sort(names)

                if #names == 0 then
                    utilprint(TAG .. "no players on the skip list.")
                else
                    utilprint(TAG .. "never recorded: " .. table.concat(names, ", "))
                end
                local pn = 0
                for _ in pairs(players) do pn = pn + 1 end
                utilprint("$w  /loot consent <name>           add or remove a player")
                utilprint("$w  " .. (pn > 0
                    and ("Players plugin also vouching for " .. commas(pn) .. " known name(s).")
                    or "Players plugin not installed or hasn't swept yet - names only from this list."))
                utilprint("$K  You can't loot a player's corpse without consent, so anyone who")
                utilprint("$K  consented to you belongs here - their gear isn't drop data.$w")
            else
                local n = low(rest)
                if consent[n] then
                    consent[n] = nil
                    utilprint(TAG .. rest .. " removed from the skip list.")
                else
                    consent[n] = true

                    -- they were probably recorded before you said so
                    local gone = 0
                    for key, r in pairs(rows.loot) do
                        if low(r.mob or "") == n then
                            rows.loot[key] = nil
                            gone = gone + 1
                        end
                    end
                    if gone > 0 then mark("loot") end

                    utilprint(TAG .. rest .. " will never be recorded as a drop source"
                        .. ((gone > 0) and (", and " .. gone .. " existing row(s) removed.") or "."))
                end
                saveTable("aw_loot_consent", consent)
            end

        elseif verb == "dedupe" then
            local renamed, merged = dedupe_variants()
            if renamed + merged == 0 then
                utilprint(TAG .. "nothing to collapse - no variant rows found.")
            else
                utilprint(TAG .. "collapsed " .. (renamed + merged) .. " variant row(s) - "
                    .. renamed .. " renamed, " .. merged .. " merged.")
            end

        elseif verb == "resync" then
            if low(rest) ~= "yes" then
                utilprint(TAG .. "'/loot resync yes' re-sends everything on the next upload.")
            else
                for _, nm in ipairs({ "loot", "gathered", "shop_stock" }) do
                    for _, r in pairs(rows[nm]) do r.synced = 0 end
                    mark(nm)
                end
                for key, letter in pairs(statIndex) do statPend[key] = letter end
                utilprint(TAG .. "all rows marked unsynced - '/loot upload' will re-send everything.")
            end

        elseif verb == "export" then
            local file = (rest ~= "") and rest or "aw-loot-export.json"
            if savePluginFile(file, serialize(SHARE_ORDER)) then
                utilprint(TAG .. "exported to " .. file
                    .. " - '/loot import " .. file .. "' reads it back.")
            else
                utilprint(TAGR .. "export failed - the file wouldn't write.")
            end

        elseif verb == "import" then
            if rest == "" then
                utilprint(TAGR .. "usage: /loot import <file>")
            else
                local text = loadPluginFile(rest)
                if type(text) ~= "string" or text == "" then
                    utilprint(TAGR .. "nothing readable at " .. rest .. ".")
                else
                    local added, seen = merge_dump(text, false)
                    if not added then
                        utilprint(TAGR .. "couldn't parse " .. rest .. ".")
                    else
                        utilprint(TAG .. "imported " .. commas(added) .. " new row(s) ("
                            .. commas(seen) .. " read). They upload with the next '/loot upload'.")
                    end
                end
            end

        elseif verb == "clear" then
            local map = { loot = "loot", shop = "shop_stock",
                          gathered = "gathered", stats = "item_stats" }
            local name = map[low(rest)]

            if not name then
                utilprint(TAGR .. "usage: /loot clear loot | shop | gathered | stats")
            else
                --[[
                    The backup is written FIRST and the clear only happens if it
                    worked. A clear you can't undo is the exact thing this
                    exists to prevent.
                ]]
                local file, why = bak_write(name)
                if not file then
                    utilprint(TAGR .. "not clearing - " .. tostring(why) .. ".")
                else
                    if name == "item_stats" then
                        for key, letter in pairs(statIndex) do
                            load_bucket(letter)[key] = nil
                            mark("stats:" .. letter)
                        end
                        statIndex, statPend = {}, {}
                    else
                        rows[name] = {}
                        mark(name)
                    end

                    utilprint(TAG .. name .. " cleared - " .. why
                        .. " row(s) saved to " .. file .. ". '/loot restore' brings them back.")
                end
            end

        elseif verb == "restore" then
            local idx = bak_index()

            if rest == "" then
                local any = false
                for name, list in pairs(idx) do
                    for i, b in ipairs(list) do
                        any = true
                        utilprint("$w  " .. name .. " " .. i .. "   " .. b.rows
                            .. " row(s)   " .. os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", b.at))
                    end
                end
                if not any then utilprint(TAG .. "no backups yet.") end
                utilprint("$w  /loot restore <table> [n]      newest is 1")
            else
                local which, n = string.match(rest, "^(%S+)%s*(%d*)$")
                local map = { loot = "loot", shop = "shop_stock",
                              gathered = "gathered", stats = "item_stats" }
                local name = map[low(which or "")]
                local list = name and idx[name]
                local b    = list and list[tonumber(n) or 1]

                if not b then
                    utilprint(TAGR .. "no such backup - '/loot restore' lists them.")
                else
                    local text = loadPluginFile(b.file)
                    local added, seen = merge_dump(text, false)
                    if not added then
                        utilprint(TAGR .. "couldn't read " .. b.file .. ".")
                    else
                        utilprint(TAG .. "restored " .. commas(added) .. " row(s) of "
                            .. commas(seen) .. ". They upload with the next '/loot upload'.")
                    end
                end
            end

        elseif verb == "api" then
            utilprint(TAG .. "pool: " .. API_URL)
            utilprint("$w  auth: " .. (cfg.authkey ~= ""
                and ("yes, as " .. (cfg.authname ~= "" and cfg.authname or "?"))
                or "no - run '/loot auth'"))
            for _, nm in ipairs(SHARE_ORDER) do
                utilprint("$w  " .. nm .. ": " .. commas(pending_of(nm)) .. " of "
                    .. commas(count_of(nm)) .. " to sync")
            end

        elseif verb == "auth" then
            if cfg.authkey ~= "" then
                utilprint(TAG .. "already authenticated as " .. cfg.authname .. ".")
                return
            end
            local name = char_name()
            if name == "" then
                utilprint(TAGR .. "no character name yet - log in first, then '/loot auth'.")
                return
            end
            utilprint(TAG .. "registering '" .. name .. "'...")
            register(name, function(ok)
                if ok then
                    utilprint(TAG .. "authenticated as " .. cfg.authname
                        .. ". '/loot upload' and '/loot update' are ready.")
                end
            end)

        elseif verb == "upload" then upload(rest == "full")
        elseif verb == "update" then update()

        elseif verb == "wish" or verb == "idwish" then
            cfg.idwish = not cfg.idwish
            save_cfg()
            if cfg.idwish then
                utilprint(TAG .. "identify wish: yes. Identify returns the full box anywhere, "
                    .. "so auto identify is worth turning on.")
            else
                utilprint(TAG .. "identify wish: no. Auto identify stays idle - identify comes back "
                    .. "partial, and at Hester's in Aylor it comes back full but charges a fee "
                    .. "per item.")
            end

        elseif verb == "autoid" then
            cfg.autoid = not cfg.autoid
            save_cfg()

            if cfg.autoid and not cfg.idwish then
                utilprint(TAG .. "auto identify on, but idle: '/loot wish' first. Without it "
                    .. "you get a partial box you already have - or a bill, at Hester's.")
            else
                utilprint(TAG .. "auto identify " .. (cfg.autoid and "on." or "off."))
            end

        elseif verb == "idnote" then
            cfg.idnote = not cfg.idnote
            save_cfg()
            utilprint(TAG .. "id confirmations " .. (cfg.idnote and "on" or "off") .. ".")

        elseif verb == "inv" then
            cfg.inv = not cfg.inv
            save_cfg()
            utilprint(TAG .. (cfg.inv and "'inv' also sends invdata, so bags are learned."
                or "'inv' goes to the MUD untouched."))

        elseif verb == "bags" then
            if rest ~= "" then
                cfg.bags = rest
                exclude = csv_set(rest)
                save_cfg()
            end
            utilprint(TAG .. "bag words: " .. set_csv(exclude))

        elseif verb == "flags" then
            if rest ~= "" then
                cfg.flags = rest
                bonus_flags = csv_set(rest)
                save_cfg()
            end
            utilprint(TAG .. "bonus flags: " .. set_csv(bonus_flags))

        elseif verb == "appraise" then
            if low(rest) == "stop" then
                local left = appraise_halt()
                utilprint(TAG .. "bulk appraise stopped (" .. left .. " left).")
            else
                local lo, hi = string.match(rest, "^(%d+)%s*-%s*(%d+)$")
                if lo then bulk_appraise(lo, hi)
                else utilprint(TAGR .. "usage: /loot appraise <from>-<to>") end
            end

        else
            utilprint(TAG .. "records what drops from what.")
            utilprint("$w  /loot                          what's in the database")
            utilprint("$w  /loot item <text>              where an item drops from")
            utilprint("$w  /loot mob <text>               what a mob drops")
            utilprint("$w  /loot shop <text>              shop stock seen")
            utilprint("$w  /loot gathered <text>          room resources seen")
            utilprint("$w  /loot stats <text>             the identify box, stored")
            utilprint("$w  /loot recent                   the last few things picked up")
            utilprint("$w  /loot del <exact name>         drop every row for one item")
            utilprint("$w  /loot appraise <a>-<b>         appraise a shop's range, paced")
            utilprint("$w  /loot auth                     join the shared pool")
            utilprint("$w  /loot upload [full]            contribute what's new")
            utilprint("$w  /loot update                   pull everyone else's")
            utilprint("$w  /loot here <keyword>           pick it up and record the spawn")
            utilprint("$w  /loot id <keyword>             identify something")
            utilprint("$w  /loot consent [name]           players never recorded as a source")
            utilprint("$w  /loot dedupe                   collapse bonus-loot variants")
            utilprint("$w  /loot export | import <file>   share a dump with a clanmate")
            utilprint("$w  /loot clear <table>            wipe one table, backing it up first")
            utilprint("$w  /loot restore [table] [n]      put a backup back")
            utilprint("$w  /loot resync yes               re-send everything next upload")
            utilprint("$w  /loot api                      pool endpoint and sync counts")
            utilprint("$w  /loot wish                     say you have the identify wish")
            utilprint("$K  Full stats come from the wish, or from 'identify' at Hester's in")
            utilprint("$K  Aylor. Either way the box is read as it scrolls past - nothing here")
            utilprint("$K  needs to ask for one.$w")
            utilprint("$w  /loot autoid | idnote | inv    toggles")
            utilprint("$w  /loot bags | flags [csv]       word lists")
        end
    end, "records what drops from what, shop stock and identify boxes")

    status()
end
